chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, a hun leh a nite thu gelh a, kong piak nading a om kei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, zan a, gutate hong pai mah bangin Topa’ Ni in hong tung ding hi ci-in note mah in a tel takin na thei uh hi.

Amaute in, “Nopsakna a om hi, launa om lo hi,” ci-in a gen lai takun, ta gai numei tungah ta suah hun gimna a tun’ bangin amaute tungah kisiatna gal in thakhatin tung ding a, suahtakna neukha beek a ngah kei ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin ute naute aw, tua Ni in guta mi bangin note tungah a hong tun’ nadingin ah note in khuamial lakah a om na hi kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note khempeuh in khuavak’ tate, sun lai’ tate na hi uh hi. Eite in zan tawh ahi zongin, khuamial tawh ahi zongin a kipawl i hi kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin adang mite a ihmut bangun eite ihmu loin, pilvangin kikem ni.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a ihmu mite in zanin a ihmu thei uh hi. A kham a guite in zong zanin a kham thei uh hi.

Eite i hih leh, sun lai tawh kipawl mite i hih ciangin ei mahmah kikepna nei-in, upna leh itna tawh kipawl awmdalna ahi zongin, bulhin, gupkhiatna’ lametna tawh kipawl siklukhu ahi zongin khu-in om ni.

Hehna thuak dingin Pasian in eite hong koih ahi kei hi. I Topa Zeisu Khazih hangin gupna i ngah nadingin hong koih a, eite i hing lai ahi zongin, i si zo ahi zongin Topa tawh i hin’ khawm nadingin, eite tangdingin sihna a thuak zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in na hihsa uh bangin, khat leh khat kihansuah un la, khat leh khat kikipsak un.
Tua tham loin, ute naute aw, note lakah nasep a hahkatte leh Topa sungah hong makaih a, thu hong hilh mite na ciamteh un la,
a bawlnate hangah ki-itna lungsim tawh na zahtak nadingun, kote in kong thuum uh hi. Khat leh khat kilemin na om un.
Ute naute aw, thadah zulhtat mite a kikep nadingun na hilh un, lungsim zawmte na hansuah un, thanemte na huh un, mi khempeuh tungah na lungduai un.
Mi dangte tungah hehna na thukkik loh nadingun na kikeem un. Khat leh khat tungah ahi zongin, mi khempeuh tungah ahi zongin thuhoih lamsang hahkat tawntungin na bawl un.
A tawntungin na lungdam ta un.
Thungen niloh un.
Na khempeuh ah a hong hehpihna phat un. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note in tua bang na bawl dingun Zeisu Khazih hangah Pasian’ deihna ahi hi.
Kha Siangtho’ huhna na mitsak kei un.
Pasian kamsangte’ thu na simmawh kei un.
Na khempeuh sinin ahoih nate na len tawntung un;
khialhna nam kim na tang un.
Nopna hong pia Pasian mah in note khempeuh hong siangthosak ta hen. Note lungsim, na kha leh na pumpi uh, i Topa Zeisu Khazih hong pai kik ciangin mawhsakna tawh a kipelh nadingun hong keem ta hen.
Note a hong sampa in thuman tawh dim ahih ciangin, tua bangin a hong bawl ding hi.
Ute naute aw, kote ading thu hong ngetsak un.
Ute naute khempeuh, a siangtho kinapna tawh na kihopih un.
Hih lai ute naute khempeuh kiangah na simsak nadingun Topa paulamin note thu kong pia uh hi.
I Topa Zeisu Khazih’ hehpihna thupha note tungah om ta hen.
